title: Animal Tower Stack
description: Balance quirky elephants, pandas, and giraffes one atop another in charming physics stacking—keep your swaying animal pyramid upright to set sky-high records.
controls: Position and rotate each cute animal overhead, then release gently to balance it atop your towering stack.

zh-CN.title: 动物叠高楼
zh-CN.description: 治愈魔性物理堆叠动物叠高楼：把圆滚滚的大象、熊猫和长颈鹿一只只稳稳叠上高空，考验重心平衡笑料十足！
zh-CN.controls: 调整上方可爱小动物的落点位置与角度，松手稳稳叠在动物高塔上不倒塌。
